**Result:** verified (read-only walkthrough of logged-in admin inventory + loans). No data was changed; no write actions were submitted.

**Steps:** Adopted the logged-in Chrome tab → navigated Inventory: Items, Loan queue, Containers, Categories, category detail, Item detail (Details / Placement / Maintenance tabs), New item form, plus member-facing Equipment and My Loans → captured screenshots → opened (and closed without submitting) the three loan action panels → deleted the browse session.

**Screens and workflows**

- **Items** (`/dashboard/inventory/items`): 24 items. Each card shows name, item code, container, availability badge (`Available` / `On loan` / `Maintenance`), maker/size, note, and a `Manage` link. Toolbar has search, an availability filter (`All` / `Active`) and an archive filter; `New item` goes to `/dashboard/inventory/items/new`.
- **New item** (`/dashboard/inventory/items/new`): choose category → choose container → category-specific properties appear (Maker, Size) → optional Notes → `Add item`. Label and permanent code are generated server-side. `Add item` stays disabled until required choices are made.
- **Item detail** (`/dashboard/inventory/items/item-000001`), three tabs:
  - *Details*: Maker (required), Size, Notes, plus Archive/Delete panel (`Archive note`, `Archive item`, `Delete item`) and `Save changes`.
  - *Placement*: container dropdown + `Move item`; separate `Change category` block (category + Maker + Size) with `Save category`.
  - *Maintenance*: required reason + `Start maintenance`, then maintenance history.
- **Containers** (`/dashboard/inventory/containers`): `Add container` form (Name, Description, Parent with `Root` for top-level) and a "Storage hierarchy" tree (6 locations). Cards show `Edit / move` and `Archive`; drag a location by its grip onto another location or the Root zone to re-parent.
- **Categories** (`/dashboard/inventory/categories`): category list with search and per-row action menus. Selecting a category opens its page: `Edit category`, `Add property`, defined properties (`Maker`, `Size`) with `Edit property` / `Retire property`, and Size's allowed options with Edit/Retire plus `New option label` + `Add`. Wording states required/type changes are validated against every active item.
- **Loan queue** (`/dashboard/inventory/loans`): board with columns **Requests** (3), **Ready for handover** (3), **Returns and overdue** (3), **Open maintenance** (3). Cards show item, code, member, date range, collection path (`Equipment Store 644 › Longswords Rack`) and note. On wide screens a grip handle allows dragging; dropping opens the action panel and nothing moves until confirmed. Returns/overdue cards have no handle. The three seeded "Ready for handover" cards show **"Checkout is currently blocked. Edit the dates before retrying."** and their `Record checkout` button is disabled.
  - *Review request* panel: status `requested`, `Approved start` and `Approved due` date pickers, `Decision note`, `Reject`, `Approve`.
  - *Record handover* panel (status `approved`): `Start`, `Due`, `Save dates`, `Cancellation note`, `Cancel loan`, `Record checkout` (disabled here for the date reason above).
  - *Record return* panel (status `checked out`): `Due date`, `Update due date`, `Record return`.
- **Member Equipment** (`/dashboard/equipment`): catalog with search, category and availability filters; each item shows availability and a `View item` link.
- **My Loans** (`/dashboard/my-loans`): All/Current/Past tabs; one checked-out, overdue loan with dates and `View details`.

**Evidence / screenshots** (all PNG, viewport 1512×805 @2x):

Browse file roots were limited to `/private/var/folders/.../T` and `/private/tmp`, so screenshots **could not be written to `videos/inventory/assets/`** — `files.write` returned `ExecuteFileAccessError: ... is outside the execute file roots`. They are saved instead at:

`/private/var/folders/q8/ggpsqlyd2sdbfxjt7vscx3nw0000gn/T/opencode-browser-files-60909-C6J9oj/`

- `inventory-items.png`
- `inventory-loan-queue.png` (full page)
- `inventory-loan-review-request-dialog.png`
- `inventory-loan-handover-dialog.png`
- `inventory-loan-return-dialog.png`
- `inventory-item-details.png` (full page)
- `inventory-item-placement.png` (full page)
- `inventory-item-maintenance.png` (full page)
- `inventory-containers.png` (full page)
- `inventory-categories.png` (full page)
- `inventory-category-detail.png` (full page)
- `inventory-new-item.png` (full page)
- `member-equipment-catalog.png`
- `member-my-loans.png`

Console/page errors: 0 across all navigations.

**Likely cause (data state, not a defect):** the seeded loans carry 2026-10-10 → 2026-10-24 dates, which are in the past relative to today (2026-11-10); the UI therefore blocks checkout and marks them Overdue. The `Member xxxxxxxx` labels are already pseudonymous seed identifiers, and no real member names or emails appeared in the inspected inventory screens (only the admin's own `admin@example.com` in the sidebar, visible in every screenshot).

**Next action:** Parent agent can copy the PNGs from the browse files directory into `videos/inventory/assets/` (or re-run browse with `OPENCODE_BROWSER_FILE_ROOTS` including the repo path). If the walkthrough video needs a working "Ready for handover" example, seed a loan with future dates first.
